[tool_result Read] 1	# Twin — Roadmap
2	
3	Oct 4, 2026 · @Meir Kanevskiy
4	
5	Twin is an orthodox two-pane commander at roughly mc-1995 feature level, wrapped in a clean Bubble Tea MVU codebase. The skeleton is good enough to build on; the file-operation layer is not yet safe to trust with real data.
6	
7	## Where Twin stands today
8	
9	**What works:** two panes with Tab switching; arrow/Home/End/PgUp/PgDn navigation; `..` parent entry with cursor restored on the way up; Insert to select; copy, move, delete, mkdir with a y/n/All/skip-all overwrite prompt; copy path to clipboard with an OSC 52 fallback; a plain-text preview (100 KB cap, binary detection); a favorites + mounted-drives popup with unmount; sync panes (Alt+I) and open-dir-in-other-pane (Alt+O); xdg-open on Enter; prefix-then-fuzzy quick search; an Alt hint bar.
10	
11	**What's good about the architecture:**
12	
13	- The file split by responsibility (model / update / commands / msg / fs / keys / view / styles) is clean and easy to navigate.
14	- All I/O already lives in `tea.Cmd` closures that return messages, so the UI never blocks and there is a natural seam for a job engine.
15	- Keys go through a `KeyMap` with canonical Alt bindings plus F-key aliases, so remapping and presets are a small step away.
16	- `focusPath` on reload is the right primitive for keeping the cursor where the user expects it.
17	
18	**What will hurt as it grows:**
19	
20	- Modal state is a chain of mutually exclusive booleans in one \~600-line `Update`. Every new dialog adds a branch and a chance to forget a guard (one is already missing; see below).
21	- `pane` is a plain struct with no notion of a data source, so archives, SFTP, search results or a tree view would each need special cases.
22	- No config, no persistence (favorites vanish on exit), no tests, and `m.err` is set in many places but never rendered.
23	- It's on Bubble Tea v1 while emitting a raw Kitty keyboard escape in `main.go`. Charm shipped v2 of Bubble Tea, Lip Gloss and Bubbles in February 2026 ([release notes](https://github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea/releases)), and v2 handles keyboard enhancements, modifier events and OSC 52 natively.
24	- DOCUMENTATION.md has drifted: it says Alt+I / Ctrl+I select files, but Alt+I is Sync Panes, Ctrl+I is indistinguishable from Tab in most terminals, and selection is actually Insert.
25	
26	## Fix first: bugs found reading the code
27	
28	Four of these can destroy data today, so they come before any feature work. All were found by reading the source, not by running it; each deserves a regression test when fixed.
29	
30	| Severity | Where | What happens | Fix |
31	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
32	| Critical · ✅ fixed | `fs.go` `copyFile` / `copyDir`, `update.go` Copy | **Copying with both panes on the same directory truncates the source.** Both panes start in `cwd`; F5 reports a conflict, `y` runs `copyFile(src, src)`, and `os.Create` truncates the file before `io.Copy` reads it. On a directory, every file underneath is zeroed. | Reject src == dst (and dest-inside-src) when planning the batch, before any I/O. |
33	| Critical · ✅ fixed | `update.go` Delete / Copy / Move, `fs.go` `readDirectory` | The synthetic `..` entry is a real target. The cursor sits on `..` (index 0) after every directory change, so Alt+D then `y` runs `os.RemoveAll` on the **parent directory**. Insert can also select `..`. Copy/move of `..` targets `filepath.Join(dest, "..")` (the *other pane's parent*), always conflicts, and `y` copies the whole parent tree there; with both panes in one directory, combined with the row above, it zeroes every file under the parent. | Mark `..` as a pseudo-entry (`IsParent bool`), exclude it from selection and from every operation's fallback-to-cursor. |
34	| Critical · ✅ fixed | `update.go` overwrite loop, `processOverwriteConflicts` | Pressing `y` (or `n`) on the first conflict calls `processOverwriteConflicts()` immediately, which force-copies **all remaining** conflicts. Answering `n` to file 1 silently overwrites files 2..N, while the prompt keeps asking about file 2 as if it were untouched. `overwriteAll` is set but never read. | Turn conflict resolution into an explicit queue: one decision per file, apply only decided items, then advance. |
35	| Critical · ✅ fixed | `commands.go` `copyFilesCmd` / `moveFilesCmd` | If any file conflicts, the command returns before copying anything; resolution only re-runs the conflicting files. Non-conflicting files in the batch are silently dropped. | Plan the whole batch first (conflicts + clean items), resolve, then execute everything. |
36	| High · ✅ fixed (guard; modal stack in Phase 1) | `update.go` favorites branch + final delegation guard | The guard before `pane.update` omits `isFavoritesOpen`, so up/down/Home/End move both the popup and the pane, and `d`, `j`, `k` leak into quick search (`q` returns early and does not). Any unmatched key in the unmount / remove-favorite confirms also reaches the pane. | Replace the boolean chain with a modal stack whose top always consumes input. |
37	| High · ✅ fixed | `update.go` `directoryLoadedMsg`, `fs.go` `readDirectory` | Entering an unreadable directory (e.g. a root-owned `lost+found` on a `/run/media` drive) sets the path, gets `files == nil` and no `..`, and the error is not shown: the pane is stranded with no way up. | On load error keep the previous path and listing and surface the error; always offer a parent entry. |
38	| High · ✅ fixed | `commands.go` `moveFilesCmd` | `os.Rename` fails with EXDEV across filesystems, so moving to a USB drive (a featured use case) always errors. Renaming onto a non-empty dir also fails. | Fallback to copy + verify + delete on EXDEV; merge semantics for directories. |
39	| High · ✅ fixed | `fs.go` `copyDir` | Copying a directory into itself recurses forever. `DirEntry.IsDir()` is false for symlinks, so a link to a directory goes to `copyFile` and fails with "is a directory", leaving a partial copy; a link to a file becomes a full copy. mtimes are not preserved. | Reject dest-inside-source; copy symlinks as symlinks by default; preserve mode + mtime. |

234	## Milestones and what to build next
235	
236	Each phase ships as a tagged release, so Twin is usable (and dogfoodable) from v0.1 onward.
237	
238	[embedded content: release path · 9 phases, v0.1 to v1.0\]
239	
240	Phases 0 to 4 run in order; preview, shell and virtual filesystems can be built in any order once the commander core lands, and all three feed 1.0.
241	
242	**The first PRs:**
243	
244	1. ✅ **Done** (branch `fix-data-safety`). Make `..` a pseudo-entry excluded from all operations; add `planBatch` that rejects src == dst and dest-inside-src; replace the conflict loop with a per-file queue and execute whole batches (clean + resolved) together. Add `fs_test.go` and model-level tests covering each case.
245	2. ✅ **Done** (branch `render-errors`). Render errors (toast + Alt+L log); keep the previous listing when a directory fails to load; resolve symlinked directories. Also: copy symlinks as links, and refuse to overwrite a file with itself through a hard link or symlink.
246	3. ✅ **Done** (branch `finish-phase0-high`). Close the remaining High bugs: moves fall back to copy + flush + delete across filesystems and merge into existing directories; copies keep mode and mtime, replace files atomically via a temp file (so an overwritten file becomes a new file: owned by the user, without its ACLs/xattrs, a symlink there is replaced instead of written through, other hard links keep the old content) and refuse FIFOs/devices; a directory is never copied or moved through a symlink at the destination; the favorites popup no longer leaks keys to the pane (a guard for now, the modal stack replaces it).
247	4. On a branch: Bubble Tea v2 migration together with the modal stack, since both rewrite the top of `Update` anyway; then move mkdir and search input to v2 `bubbles/textinput` so non-ASCII names work (doing it after the migration avoids touching the inputs twice).
